tasks.description: Compute the Soil Fertility Index (SFI) based on organic matter and NPK levels to assess soil fertility.
Calculate the Temperature-Humidity Index (THI) to evaluate crop stress due to heat and moisture.
Determine the Nutrient Balance Ratio (NBR) to analyze the balance between nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium in the soil.
Calculate the Water Availability Index (WAI) to assess the composite availability of soil moisture and rainfall.
Estimate the Photosynthesis Potential (PP) based on sunlight exposure, CO2 concentration, and temperature.
Classify the current growth stage of the crop based on environmental parameters and soil conditions.
Assess the level of pest infestation pressure using the pest pressure index from sensor data.
Analyze fertilizer usage patterns to optimize application rates based on soil nutrient levels.
Continuously monitor and report soil moisture levels to ensure optimal irrigation practices.
Evaluate the frequency of irrigation to optimize water usage based on crop needs and soil moisture.
